scope: Exact local subset and saved one-epoch checkpoint

purpose.description: A baseline for studying character-level language learning and narrative generation.
purpose.uncertainty: Desired capabilities need separate held-out tests.

source_and_unit.description: 20,000 filtered unique stories, selected sequentially then shuffled; 18,000/2,000 story split.
source_and_unit.uncertainty: Not a uniform full-corpus sample; generator/model/prompt-family mixture is not retained.

topics_and_knowledge.description: Reviewed examples include family, play, animals, school, food, communication and work.
topics_and_knowledge.uncertainty: Multi-label topic prevalence and rare-topic coverage remain unmeasured.

reasoning_operations.description: Pilot narratives contain goals, actions, consequences, event sequences, preferences and object/location updates.
reasoning_operations.uncertainty: These are mostly implicit signals, not validated coverage of explicit Nous tasks or learned ability.

supervision_and_solution_structure.description: Plain stories are trained by next-character prediction; no independently verified reasoning targets or rationales are provided.
supervision_and_solution_structure.uncertainty: Useful narrative relations may be implicit; self-contained prose is not a solution-verification method.

language_and_communication.description: Normalized printable ASCII with an observed 80-character vocabulary; narrative and dialogue styles appear in the pilot.
language_and_communication.uncertainty: The existing lexical factors do not constitute a validated syntactic/style taxonomy.

quality.description: The pilot records word-meaning, causal-bridge and entity/action issues, alongside valid anthropomorphic fiction.
quality.uncertainty: No corpus-wide defect rate or independent rater agreement is available.

difficulty_and_prerequisites.description: Full per-story checkpoint loss is measured for 2,000 held-out stories.
difficulty_and_prerequisites.uncertainty: Loss reflects predictability under this model/protocol; it is not a semantic quality or general difficulty score.

dependency_and_context.description: All retained stories exceed the 256-character context; the median training story spans about three such windows.
dependency_and_context.uncertainty: Dependency distances are not annotated; changing evaluation windows does not establish the effect of longer-context training.

diversity_and_redundancy.description: Exact cross-split overlap was zero. Existing lexical similarity checks and repeated phrases are available.
diversity_and_redundancy.uncertainty: Semantic duplicate families and generator-template families remain unmeasured.

balance_and_exposure.description: The longest 20% of training stories contribute 34.01% of story characters; record and character mixes differ.
balance_and_exposure.uncertainty: Characters exclude story separators; exposure does not directly measure gradient influence.

annotation_trust.description: The fixed 32-story review and new pilot annotations are one assistant pass.
annotation_trust.uncertainty: No independent review, calibrated rubric or population-level semantic labels yet.

leakage_and_generalization.description: Held-out stories were split from the selected upstream training file.
leakage_and_generalization.uncertainty: This is not the upstream official validation split; paraphrase leakage is unresolved.

model_compatibility.description: The recorded model uses an 80-character alphabet, 256-character blocks, and packed story boundaries without a special EOS token.
model_compatibility.uncertainty: Different tokenization, boundaries or context would be separate training interventions.

empirical_utility.description: A one-epoch baseline exists; the new full packed validation loss is 1.029617.
empirical_utility.uncertainty: No equal-budget mix intervention or repeated training-seed study has established which slices improve learning.

access_and_reproducibility.description: Exact data, source hashes, checkpoint lineage, audit code and outputs are available; story text retains CDLA-Sharing-1.0.
access_and_reproducibility.uncertainty: Reproduction of the audit code expects the documented original Runpod paths and environment.
